name: remember
title: Remember typing every field into one box, and picking GET or POST?
part: How the human Web did it
html:
Remember typing every field into one box, and picking GET or POST?

1 · Find the act

Open forms.html, scroll to RENEW A LOAN.

2 · Pick the method

POST from the browser’s menu.

3 · Type the address

/loans/{loanId}/renew, with your loan number filled in by hand.

4 · Type the body

card=…&pin=…, exactly as shown.

Fiction A 1997 that never happened, built and run for real: Perl CGI behind Apache.
say: Quick show of hands. Remember when, to renew a library book, you opened the site's forms.html page, scrolled to RENEW A LOAN, picked POST from your browser's method menu, typed the address with your loan number in it, and typed card equals your card number, ampersand, pin equals your PIN, into the body box? This is a fictional browser, WebWalker, on a fictional 1997 web that was built and run for real for a talk called Overheard at Riverside: Perl CGI, Apache, the lot. Every screen here is that site, answering.
